notes:
- New plug-in — DT Ducker: a drawable sidechain-pump. Sketch the volume shape with movable start/middle/end points, shift-click the graph to add more, and bend any segment Ableton-style. Runs tempo-synced (quarter-note pump out of the box) or one-shot from an external sidechain input — feed it a kick and the pattern fires on every hit. Fresh instances open on the "Caleb's Default" pump.
- DT Tremolo: square and saw shapes no longer click or pop — the gain edges are micro-smoothed so it stays choppy without the ticking.
- DT Trance Gate: per-step pitch with a label under each step (double-click to type a semitone, or scroll / shift-drag to nudge). The pitch engine was reworked so shifted steps are instant and click-free instead of audibly "scratching" up/down. Bigger grab zones for the level/length handles, and an option for more steps.
- DT Distortion: "Match Loudness" now ships OFF by default, so presets no longer come in hotter than expected.
- DT Lo-Fi: reworked vinyl-noise so it sounds like a record surface, not random clicks.
- DT EQ / filters: live spectrum behind the curve, and Alt/Option-click a band to bypass it.
- DT Delay: the trailing repeat visualizer now lights each tap in time with host playback.
- Per-plug-in tutorials: every DT plug-in now has a built-in mini-tutorial (shown once on first open, re-openable from the presets menu) that also lists that plug-in's keyboard shortcuts. Preset menus gained "Save current as default."
- Automation: cleaner, host-friendly parameter names across DAWs.
- What's-new: after an in-app update, each DT plug-in shows a one-time "What's new" panel on relaunch, just like EXCESS.
- Stability: the safety net on every DT effect continues to scrub non-finite samples and hard-limit runaway levels, so nothing can produce an ear-damaging spike.
